outcome.Summary: Rewrote Map in pool/pool.go: the coordinator goroutine now tracks jobs by index, so out[i] is always fn(ctx, in[i]) regardless of arrival order; a select loop stops dispatching new inputs as soon as a call fails or ctx is cancelled, then drains all in-flight results (with a `stop` channel so no worker can ever block on an abandoned send), and guarantees no goroutine leaks by closing channels and wg.Wait() before returning. The return value follows the doc: nil + *IndexError for the lowest failing index (when a failure predates cancellation), ctx.Err() on cancellation, else the ordered results. Added tests in pool/pool_extra_test.go covering order with 16 workers, lowest-index error selection, stop-on-failure, cancellation (including a pre-cancelled context), failure-beats-later-cancellation, and empty input. Verified with `go test -race -count=1 ./...` (exit 0) and repeated `-count=5` runs under the race detector.
